navigation.implementation_note: Choose a Discord-supported search/picker interaction during implementation; do not promise live filtering without verifying it.
navigation.principle: Few top-level commands; discover related actions through clickable menus instead of memorizing separate commands.

control_center.scope: Settings and capability visibility for the current category computer; model defaults affect future sessions only. Detailed scope of new menu sections remains to discuss.
control_center.choose_existing_thread: not part of current agreed control-center settings flow after user correction

switch_shortcut.settings_overlap: No model selector in thread settings; control-center settings handles future-session defaults only.
switch_shortcut.selection_flow: Choose a model; resolve its harness automatically, with no separate harness step.

user_correction: Thread settings are not for model changes; thread session commands differ from control-center commands.

default_model_picker.scope: future sessions in current category only
default_model_picker.harness_resolution: Automatically select the compatible configured harness associated with the chosen model on the current category computer.

user_corrections: Do not organize model selection by harness; select the harness automatically from the chosen model.
Prefer selectable options within a few commands; fold the skills inventory into /settings rather than adding /skills.

additional_settings.user_answer: A, B and C; discuss each one separately
additional_settings.browser_starting_folder_definition: Where folder browsing opens initially; it does not automatically select the new session working directory or restrict browsing elsewhere.
additional_settings.user_correction: Nah, not A; we do not need notification controls.
user_corrections: Automatic capacity is default behavior; do not expose a concurrency setting.

notification_noise.recipient: requester of the corresponding turn, as already agreed
notification_noise.note: No runtime notification behavior is changed by this planning choice.

browser_starting_folder.new_session_flow: Favorites, Recent and Browse remain available.

concurrency.user_answer: Should be as much as the computer can handle.
concurrency.policy: Automatically admit as much simultaneous work as the computer and configured model provider can sustain; queue additional requests when capacity is constrained.
concurrency.manual_limit_picker: Not needed in the normal user flow.
implementation_notes: Current limiter is a fixed semaphore; automatic scheduling is a new requirement, not current behavior.
Measure actual resource pressure and task demand; do not infer a universally safe limit from CPU count or free RAM alone.
Respect observed provider throttling and subscription limits; do not probe with paid load tests without authorization.
Preserve current limits until adaptive behavior is implemented and verified.

verified_current_local_capacity.source: Live local /api/sessions during this design turn

skills_inventory.purpose: Browse and search skills on this computer, see their purpose and verified availability across harnesses.
skills_inventory.installation_or_sync: not authorized by this design discussion

candidate_sections_not_agreed.memory: View and manage remembered preferences and facts, with ownership and sharing still to define.
candidate_sections_not_agreed.backups_and_recovery: Recover earlier bot settings after a bad change; exact backup scope and restore behavior still to define.

planning_scope: Finish control-center menu inventory, then discuss each section one at a time; thread commands remain deferred. Acceptance of menu sections is not implementation authorization.

natural_language_access.coverage: Every supported settings menu action must also be available through natural-language session requests.
natural_language_access.commands_role: Discoverable, explicit and dependable alternative; no requirement to type a command to change settings.
natural_language_access.execution: Use the same validated control operations and persistent state as the corresponding menu action; verify and report the actual outcome.
natural_language_access.scope: Resolve current-session versus future-session/category defaults from the request; retain category and personal ownership boundaries, clarify genuinely ambiguous targets.
natural_language_access.limitations: Observe the same access and capability limits as menus, including owner-only sign-in steps or offline computers; never claim an unavailable change succeeded.
examples: Set the default model for new sessions in this category to [model].
Show which skills all the harnesses here can use.
